work: Build a raw model/tool loop with an explicit state machine, typed tool arguments, max steps, terminal result, and fake deterministic model responses. Read H1/H2.
evidence: Unit scenarios for successful tool use, malformed call, exception, timeout, and step-budget exhaustion
title: Build the Model and Tool Loop

work: Add read/search/write tools confined to a disposable workspace; mock command execution until Activity 3 isolation. Outline a 24-task suite (8 development, 16 final) and build the first 3 development fixtures.
evidence: First 3 development tasks run end-to-end; full traces include tool calls, outcomes, time, and cost
title: Add Workspace Tools and Task Fixtures

work: Introduce fresh-process/container execution, timeouts, output caps, workspace boundaries, and host-side tool authorization. Keep credentials outside task environments.
evidence: Automated tests for path traversal/symlinks, infinite process, excessive output, and unauthorized network/tool requests
title: Enforce Tool and Process Execution Boundaries

work: Implement append-only events, stable run IDs, failure categories, and mock-model replay. Complete the 8 development fixtures; verify their reference solutions and broken/no-op controls, then run the development suite.
evidence: A small development report and a trace viewer or readable CLI; no final-task result inspection
title: Record Events and Evaluate Development Tasks

work: Build the shared evaluator, connect a pinned provider through the added adapter bridge, and enforce pre-request budgets. Compare the typed-tool harness with pinned mini-SWE-agent on two development tasks as a descriptive systems pilot; disclose prompt/tool differences. Read H3/H4/H9.
evidence: Both systems run from one command with recorded common model/task/resource constraints and explicit interface differences; no causal context-policy claim.
title: Build the Evaluator and Compare Baselines

work: Implement bounded repository navigation using file listing, exact search, selected reads, and output truncation. Test one context-selection policy on development tasks.
evidence: At least one controlled experiment and a written account of where retrieval lost necessary evidence
title: Experiment With Bounded Repository Navigation

work: Persist model messages, tool outcomes, workspace version, and run state. Implement resume semantics; uncertain mutating actions require reconciliation instead of blind replay. Read H5.
evidence: Interrupt before/after a tool action, restart, and demonstrate that edits are not duplicated silently
title: Persist Agent State and Implement Resume

work: Implement one context-compaction policy retaining objective, decisions, evidence pointers, changed files, and pending actions. Contrast it with a bounded recent-history baseline on development tasks.
evidence: Explicit compaction budget and a failure case where summarization dropped essential information
title: Compare Context Compaction With Recent History

work: Expose one existing read/search tool through the official MCP SDK. Compare this adapter with direct function invocation. Read H6.
evidence: Same functional outcome; capability/permission check still occurs outside model output; protocol smoke test
title: Expose One Existing Tool Through MCP

work: After the three added fixture-authoring hours produce twelve final tasks, complete the last four and validate all sixteen with reference/no-op/broken controls. Freeze the24-task manifest without agent calls. Optional Harbor setup remains bounded by the existing scheduled hour.
evidence: All 24 task IDs, fixtures, and graders frozen; optional external revisions recorded before final results
title: Freeze Final Tasks and Verify Graders
scopeNote: Harbor setup and a frozen ten-task external benchmark subset are optional; cap setup at one scheduled hour.

work: Inject failures: model timeout, rate limit, malformed arguments, tool crash, stale summary, and restart. Test retry/cancellation and bounded recovery.
evidence: Recovery tests distinguish transient failures from permanent errors and uncertain side effects
title: Inject Agent Failures and Test Recovery

work: Freeze the final hypothesis: recent-history baseline versus evidence-preserving compaction, same model and budgets. Predeclare metrics/task splits and run a development pilot that actually reaches the shared context ceiling and activates both policies. Read H8.
evidence: Written experiment plan, cost estimate, frozen harness commits, and no final-set-driven prompt tuning
title: Freeze the Matched Budget Harness Experiment

work: Evaluate the 16 final private tasks for two harness conditions and three trials per condition, subject to per-trial limits. Use deterministic outcome graders.
evidence: 96 attempted trials, with failures/timeouts included; raw traces and per-task outcome table
title: Run the Held Out Harness Evaluation

work: Analyze required private-suite failures and costs. Optionally run the frozen 10-task external subset once per condition if setup and budget gates passed.
evidence: Required private-study analysis; if run, 20 external trials labeled as a small-subset pilot, not a leaderboard score
title: Analyze Private Suite Failures and Costs
scopeNote: The twenty-trial external pilot is optional and runs only if setup and budget gates passed.

work: Audit outcome grading and budget accounting. Calculate uncertainty summaries; examine representative successes and failures without retuning the frozen result.
evidence: Per-task clustered analysis and a limitations section; follow-up ideas separated from reported experiment
title: Audit Grading Budgets and Evaluation Uncertainty

work: Write the harness report and demo restart, a successful task, and a safely terminated failure.
evidence: Reproducible commands, example traces, cost table, and one concise demonstration
title: Write the Harness Report and Demonstration
Prepare the Standalone Harness Repository
work: Create an independent Python repository, verify the local environment, and record a reproducible development workflow.
evidence: A clean repository, passing environment smoke check, and versioned setup notes.

title: Set the Evaluation and Spending Ground Rules
work: Create an evaluation notebook defining outcomes, development boundaries, and the course spending ledger before experiments begin.
evidence: An evaluation charter with a worked grading example, the 8/16 split rule, and an API spending plan.

title: Assessment: Boundaries, Events, and Development Evaluation
work: Complete a closed-book boundary assessment and demonstrate that recorded outcomes match actual tool effects.
evidence: A scored six-point assessment, one boundary trace, and a repaired or explicitly blocked gate.

title: Assessment: Resume and Context Policies
work: Test an interrupted mutation and compare two valid context payloads under one declared ceiling.
evidence: A scored six-point assessment plus a restart trace and a matched-context comparison.

title: Assessment: Authorize the Frozen Experiment
work: Audit the final manifest and development pilot before permitting any held-out agent evaluation.
evidence: A scored six-point assessment and an explicit go/no-go record for the 96-attempt study.

title: Assemble the Evidence Index
work: Connect each portfolio claim to frozen code, experiment records, and the smallest supporting artifact.
evidence: A release evidence index with every headline claim traceable to a specific artifact.

title: Run a Clean Checkout Reproduction
work: Use only the README in a fresh environment to reproduce a cheap deterministic demonstration and inspect the saved study.
evidence: A clean-checkout reproduction log with setup gaps corrected and paid reruns clearly separated.

title: Prepare One Small External Contribution
work: Turn one verified dependency or documentation issue into a minimal, reproducible contribution draft.
evidence: A focused issue or patch draft with a reproducer, or a documented no-issue finding and useful local clarification.

title: Finish the Standalone Portfolio Release
work: Create a concise project entry, audit release contents, and identify the next experiment without changing the reported result.
evidence: A reviewable release candidate with a README entry point, evidence links, and one bounded follow-up proposal.

title: Implement the Provider Message Adapter
work: Connect the raw loop to one pinned provider SDK using offline response fixtures before enabling paid requests.
evidence: A tested adapter preserves tool IDs, content blocks, stop reasons, and usage without making live calls.

title: Author Final Tasks 01–04
work: Prepare four final-task specifications with genuinely distinct behaviors, using the existing fixture/grader template.
evidence: Four new final fixtures (final-01 through final-04) with reference-pass/no-op-fail controls and recorded task families.

title: Author Final Tasks 05–08
work: Author four more final fixtures and verify their reference/no-op controls without agent runs.
evidence: Four new final fixtures (final-05 through final-08) with reference-pass/no-op-fail controls and recorded task families.

title: Author Final Tasks 09–12
work: Author four final fixtures, checking both solvability and separation from development feedback.
evidence: Four new final fixtures (final-09 through final-12) with reference-pass/no-op-fail controls and recorded task families.
